confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge of Athens prices, projected to July 2026. No live listings, booking pages or city-price sources were consulted. Restaurant anchors are moderately confident. Cocktail and wine_glass are less certain because direct knowledge is weaker, so they are bounded from the local relationship to draft beer (cocktail roughly 2.4 times beer; house wine by the glass close to beer). Accommodation is the least certain group given July peak-season volatility. The euro-to-dollar level is an approximate general-knowledge assumption, not a sourced rate, so USD values could move several percent. The FX observation was read from search summaries citing rba.gov.au and was not opened directly; a secondary market report (about 70.0 US cents) was consistent.
comparable_city_reasoning: No single comparable city was used as a source. The basis is general knowledge of Athens restaurant, bar and accommodation pricing, benchmarked against southern European capitals with similar summer tourism demand, then projected to July 2026 for local price growth since the remembered data.
